name: Barco N.V.
summary: Barco N.V., operating globally with its subsidiaries, specializes in creating cutting-edge visualization solutions tailored for the entertainment, enterprise, and healthcare industries. Its operations are segmented into three core divisions: Entertainment, Enterprise, and Healthcare. The company's extensive product portfolio includes a variety of projectors for cinema, simulation, virtual reality, and other professional installations, alongside advanced presentation switchers, screen management systems, and related control hardware. Barco also provides cutting-edge LED image processing and indoor LED displays, as well as a comprehensive range of video wall technologies, such as laser, LCD, and LED rear-projection units, complete with their controllers and upgrade kits. Further offerings encompass wireless conferencing and presentation systems, 3D sound solutions, and a variety of essential accessories like optical components and sensor units. Barco also develops specialized software for cinema and control room collaboration, alongside immersive visual display systems, including "caves," power walls, and reconfigurable screens. These products are complemented by a full suite of support, maintenance, training, and professional services. For enterprise clients, Barco delivers solutions designed for critical decision-making environments, such as command centers, control rooms, and tools supporting field operations. It also provides networked collaboration platforms for education, meetings, training facilities, and operating rooms, including AV streaming technology with encoders, decoders, and client software. Within the healthcare sector, Barco supplies clinical collaboration software, high-precision medical display systems, and integrated solutions specifically for surgical environments. Founded in 1934, Barco N.V. maintains its headquarters in Kortrijk, Belgium.
